entry.title: Rebuilding this site
entry.content:
The first version of this site went up the month I graduated, built around the assumption that I was headed straight into research. However, after my year in Washington, I rebuilding the site to match my emerging interests. The work page now reflects ongoing projects, and the resume page has a more concise outline of my work experience.

It’s a custom Jekyll theme on GitHub Pages, set in Fraunces, Newsreader, and Inter, with a few small enhancements—cross-page view transitions, a theme toggle, some scroll choreography—that degrade cleanly on older browsers. These posts will be simple Markdown files meant for quickly sharing my thoughts and work. A full website with more experimental design and interactivity is in the works, but this is a good place to start.

entry.title: Welcome to My Personal Website
entry.content:
Welcome to my new personal website! This platform will serve as a hub for sharing my research, projects, and thoughts on information science, AI, and German literature.

What to Expect

I’ll be regularly updating this site with:

  • Research findings and academic papers
  • Projects I’m working on at Columbia and beyond
  • Thoughts on emerging technologies and design
  • Interesting connections between technology, philosophy, and culture

Stay tuned for more content coming soon!
